column1: # The activity bar: slug, label, icon, seat (head, top, center, bottom),
# and what a press does (space, host, modal or tell, and which). The bar
# itself is appkit's. The row seated `head` is Phiogy's own mark: its
# icon is the logo script/logo.py draws on the font; it is drawn in the
# window's caption on a ground as the icons under it, with its name
# beside it while a menu is shown. A name in a logo is in one case
# (the user, 23 November 2026), and here the lower one: this face draws
# its capital I as a small i with a dot, so capitals would read as
# mixed. While a row has a menu the mark
# is the pin: the pointer over it shows the pin, and a press puts the
# menu away or brings it back; what the row names is done only where
# no row has a menu. After these rows the bar has one for each host
# the person is in, with its mark (`Desk::place`). A row that names
# nothing to do only shows its menu (data/menu.tsv); one that names
# something does that as well.
